claim_legs.durability: Exact Git-bound inputs, prospective source pins and complete first-run copies are tracked. Saved-only audit/recovery pass without raw-log access or fixture replay. Book, Knowledge Map, task and exact acceptance history preserve outcomes and the next frontier.
claim_legs.falsify: Unchanged recursive and independent interval/source-scope oracles agree with current actual rows; original equal-reference identity reconstruction checks distinct sources and shared archive custody. Altered rows, domains, headers, baseline predictions, recovery and book counts reject.
claim_legs.rederive: Pinned recipes and immutable actual equal-reference case records distinguish reads/closes from reported errors and retain original native identities, public attempts and effects. Original TAP and the independent book watcher recount the published domain.

commit_gate: Required staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Active-runtime and last-observation compositions, complete close-report join, genuine omissions, final release, native/lifetime and historical startup/parent/full CI/push remain open.
scope: Equal-reference inert file-fixture compositions only. Qualified pure binding, real-close-first reporting, directory-read reporting and independent trace oracles remain unchanged. Equal source bytes retain distinct native identities and share an independently identified archive copy. No ordinary fixture, other-profile fixture, prior producer/main, compiler or native process is replayed.
